item.title: Boston Crusaders percussion reunites to headline PASIC 2026
item.description:
Just over three months after stepping off the field at Lucas Oil Stadium, the 2026 Boston Crusaders percussion section reunited in Indianapolis for one final performance — headlining at PASIC 2026, the Percussive Arts Society's annual convention. The reunion brought the section back to the Circle City for an encore after their summer season ended.

For a corps percussion section, a PASIC headline slot is a significant honor, putting the group in front of the percussion world's biggest audience. It is also a fitting coda to the 2026 season: one last chance for the section to perform together before its members scatter to school, work, and next year's auditions.

item.title: Impulse returns to World Championships in 2027; Blue Knights bring back the cymbal line
item.description:
DCI's latest corps news roundup leads with Impulse returning to the World Championships in 2027, a notable comeback for the corps. Meanwhile, the Blue Knights will field their first cymbal line since 1998 — a throwback that longtime drum corps fans will appreciate.

Also in the roundup: Northern Lights unveiled a new logo, and there are updates from DCI All-Age and SoundSport. It's a quiet offseason news day overall, but the Impulse return and the Blue Knights' cymbal line revival are the items worth knowing as corps start gearing up for next summer.
